title: The Alex and Cloud AI panel
summary: The right-hand panel holds Alex and Cloud AI, one tab each, and can be hidden and shown from the left rail.
roles: Everyone

training.topic: The Alex and Cloud AI panel

title: Alex: turn on the built-in engineering co-worker
summary: Alex reads your sheet as you work and lists warnings, questions and suggestions, locally, with no language model.
roles: Anyone who may edit the sheet

title: Why “Alex”? What stays local
summary: A note in the Alex tab explains the name and that Alex sends nothing outside.
roles: Everyone

training.topic: Why Alex is a local AI

title: E1 Trainer: Alex shows you how, where you are
summary: Alex's trainer mode offers lessons for the place you are in and guides you through them with bubbles on the real buttons, each linked to this guide.
roles: Everyone; finished lessons are kept in your own browser

training.topic: Learning E1 with the E1 Trainer

title: Choose Alex's skill and level
summary: The skill decides which engineer reads the drawing; the level decides how much Alex tells you.
roles: Everyone

title: Read and act on Alex's cards
summary: Each finding is a card with why, where, and a fix, an answer field or a way to set it aside.
roles: Reading: everyone; Apply and Save need edit rights

title: Alex's marks on the drawing
summary: Warnings and questions are marked on the drawing and linked both ways to their cards; the marks can be hidden.
roles: Everyone

title: Filter Alex's findings
summary: The count chips filter the cards and marks by kind, or to the selected symbol.
roles: Everyone

title: Not applicable: hide a finding, or propose it to the company
summary: Hide a finding on this sheet, or propose that Alex never raises it at your company.
roles: Hiding: everyone; proposing: members who may propose waivers; accepting: convention approvers

training.topic: When a finding does not apply

title: Suggestions while you draw: Apply or Reject
summary: While Alex is live, Alex offers what usually comes next, such as the valves around a new pump, as ghost symbols and an After your change card to apply or reject.
roles: Anyone who may edit the sheet

title: Ask Cloud AI about an Alex card
summary: Hands an Alex finding to Cloud AI as a ready-written question that you can edit before sending.
roles: Everyone who may use Cloud AI

training.topic: A second opinion from Cloud AI

title: Teach Alex your company's conventions (Alex knowledge)
summary: Upload your standards; Alex proposes the rules it finds, and once accepted checks every drawing against them.
roles: Engineering standards owner, Library administrator or owner

title: Team memory: what is usual at your company
summary: Alex learns the usual values from your projects and suggests them on new lines.
roles: Turning it on needs the permission to approve conventions

title: Pipe class checks
summary: With your pipe classes loaded, Alex checks each line's pressure, temperature, class and sour service against them.
roles: As for Alex knowledge

title: Export the instrument index from the drawing
summary: Alex writes the instrument index, I/O list, cause and effect and motor list of a sheet into one Excel workbook.
roles: Automation or Plant engineer skill

title: Import a heat and material balance
summary: Brings a simulator's stream table into the line list, matched to lines and checked by you.
roles: Process or Plant engineer skill and permission to write values

training.topic: Importing a heat and material balance

title: Cloud AI: chat with the project
summary: A chat with a language model that answers questions about the project and, in Agent mode, changes it with review and undo.
roles: Everyone where Cloud AI is on; changes need an Editor license and a project role that may edit

title: Agent, Ask and Plan: the chat mode
summary: Agent edits the project, Ask only answers, and Plan proposes a change that waits for Apply.
roles: Everyone who may use Cloud AI

title: Review changes first: Apply or Discard
summary: Cloud AI works on a draft and nothing is stored until you click Apply.
roles: Anyone who may let Cloud AI edit

title: Protect the arrangement
summary: Cloud AI may add to the drawing but does not move, resize or reroute what is already drawn.
roles: Anyone who may let Cloud AI edit

title: Undo everything a reply changed
summary: One click on a reply takes back its whole change.
roles: Editor license and a project role that may edit

title: What is always held for review
summary: Large deletions and some commands always wait for Apply, even with Review changes first off.
roles: Everyone who lets Cloud AI edit

title: Attach files to a message
summary: Give Cloud AI a list, a specification or a screenshot; E1 reads the text and sends it with your message.
roles: Everyone who may use Cloud AI

title: Voice input
summary: Speak instead of typing; the text lands in the text box for you to edit and send.
roles: Everyone who may use Cloud AI

title: The model chip: which model answers
summary: Shows which model answers and where it runs; Editors outside a trial may pick a premium model.
roles: Everyone sees it; premium models need an Editor license outside a trial

title: Choose the installation's model (administrators)
summary: The administrator chooses the model everyone uses by default.
roles: Installation administrators

title: Engineering patterns: pump trains, instrument taps, motor feeders
summary: Cloud AI draws three common designs correctly and checks and repairs what it drew.
roles: Anyone who may edit the sheet

title: Cloud AI asks Alex
summary: Before judging a design, Cloud AI asks Alex to review the sheet with your company's conventions.
roles: Everyone who may use Cloud AI

title: Text in the project is data, not instructions
summary: Cloud AI never follows instructions written in names, notes, attributes or attached files.
roles: Everyone

title: When Cloud AI is off: everything by hand
summary: With Cloud AI off or out of credits, you work by hand with the menus, toolbars and right-click menus, and Alex keeps working.
roles: Everyone

title: Outside agents through MCP (administrators and developers)
summary: An outside AI agent can run E1's commands through the Model Context Protocol, recorded and undoable in History.
roles: Administrators and developers with access to the installation

title: Stored assistants
summary: Save work as an assistant to run again, share and package.
roles: To be decided

title: Cloud AI in your branch
summary: Cloud AI will make its changes in your own branch, and held changes will be temporary branches.
roles: To be decided

title: Queries from a sentence
summary: Type a sentence like "all pumps without a motor" and get the matching table.
roles: To be decided
